title: Staged cold-start failover with forensic KV-snapshot comparator and circuit-breaker exercise
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Conduct a scheduled active->passive cold-start failover drill that exercises circuit-breaker and load-shedding behavior while validating KV-store snapshot parity using a forensic comparator. We will boot the passive region from recent snapshots (cold start), route a controlled synthetic workload, toggle circuit-breaker thresholds to exercise graceful degradation, and compare post-restore KV state to golden snapshots to detect divergence. Success criteria include: zero data-loss beyond committed durability window, API-level SLOs met under degraded mode for prioritized routes, no silent cache corruption, and actionable observability artifacts for any divergence. This ticket covers planning, preflight checks, the drill execution plan, immediate rollback procedures, and post-drill forensic validation and follow-up remediation actions.
steps: Prep: lock config rollouts; freeze non-essential deploys for 72h window
Preflight checks: backup integrity verification for last 3 snapshots, storage access, and signer keys
Traffic isolation: enable staged traffic siphon to route 10% synthetic traffic initially, then 50%, then 100% if green
Cold start: boot passive region from s3://recovery-snapshots/2026-03-01; capture boot logs and KV restore duration
Forensic compare: run kv-forensic-compare v2.1 against golden snapshot; produce row-level delta and CRC histograms
Circuit breaker exercise: temporarily lower request concurrency to trigger CB, observe fallback paths and error rates
Load-shedding test: simulate burst workload (500 RPS) targeting low-priority routes and confirm shedding prioritizes chat-generation timeout over embeddings
SLO and alert verification: validate synthetic user journeys against latency and error-budget SLIs and confirm alert firing and runbook linking
Rollback: re-route traffic back to primary and decommission warmed passive nodes if divergence exceeds threshold
Postmortem: collate logs, diff artifacts, and draft remediation tickets for any state divergence or infra gaps
success_criteria: All prioritized APIs meet their degraded SLOs (p95 latency within configured degraded SLO) during the 10-minute steady-state window
KV forensic delta < 0.01% primary-key divergence and no missing committed writes beyond snapshot window
Circuit-breaker fallbacks occur as expected and graceful-degradation UX paths return 200-level sentinel responses for critical telemetry
Full runbook play executed without manual escalations outside the escalation plan
Artifacts (snapshots, diffs, dashboards) uploaded to Confluence and linked in this ticket
risk_assessment: Medium. Cold-starting passive region stresses snapshot restore paths and networking; the main risks are slower-than-expected KV replay causing increased request latencies and noisy reconciliation jobs that could spike IO on backing stores. Mitigations: throttle consumer replays, pre-warm KV indexes in read-only mode, monitor storage IO credits and pre-create ephemeral capacity if needed.
